title: FB-011 fail closed on invalid settings builders
summary: Fixed FR-032 by making dirty Settings builder validation failures abort Preview and Save before any API POST is sent.
reason: Worker finding W08-002 reported that invalid builder input could show a local error while Preview/Save continued with stale raw JSON, which is unsafe for settings persistence and media-policy staging.
behavior_before: Dirty Settings builders could reject invalid input locally, but Preview/Save still continued with the existing raw Changes JSON and posted it to settings preview/save routes.
behavior_after: Dirty Settings builder flushes return explicit success or failure. Preview and Save record a Builder invalid result and return before POST when any dirty builder rejects invalid JSON/text or numeric input.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_settings_builder_flush_smoke -q passed, 1 browser-backed test covering invalid JSON/text and invalid positive-number builders with no Preview/Save POST.

rollback_plan: Revert the Settings builder flush result handling and the focused browser smoke in this packet, then rerun the listed WebView/settings validation commands.
